declaration.scope: DATA COLLECTION ONLY: raw forward market data and readiness; no forward return, no checkpoint, no rule change

boundary.development_binding: the 2,152-file development manifest and its symlink view; no forward path can appear in it

source.kiwoom: not a signal source in F1; never mixed into any input
source.live: not produced; no LIVE seal, no back-dated timestamp

store.root: market_data/forward/massive (workspace, beside the frozen snapshot tree; strategy-independent)
store.reference: reference/CS_<as_of>.json.gz (development cadence: first XNYS session of each quarter; latest <= D-1 is used)
store.rvol_context: rvol_context/<DIR>/... pre-boundary minute history for symbols with no Common Raw directory (RVOL history only, never a forward observation)
store.manifests: manifests/run_<run_id>.json, one immutable manifest per run (copy under data/runtime/strategy_e_max/forward/collection/manifests)
store.quarantine: quarantine/<run_id>/ files that failed validation or were refused; kept, never deleted
store.strategy_outputs: seals / registry / sessions stay under data/runtime/strategy_e_max/forward (strategy-specific)

symbol_path_mapping.rule: storage directory = _<SYMBOL> when SYMBOL is a DOS device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, CONIN$, CONOUT$, COM0-9, LPT0-9), else SYMBOL; file names and every record keep SYMBOL
symbol_path_mapping.round_trip: storage_to_symbol(symbol_to_storage(s)) == s for every symbol; no real ticker starts with '_' so there is no collision

reuse.grouped_daily: app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.raw_fetch.fetch_grouped, unchanged, into staging; validated file moved to the forward name
reuse.splits_asof: app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.raw_fetch.fetch_splits, unchanged, into staging; validated file moved to splits_asof_<D>
reuse.reference: app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.raw_fetch.fetch_tickers, unchanged (the format of the quarterly CS_<date> seed files)
reuse.minute: app.backtest.historical_store.raw_fetch.fetch_request, unchanged, through a request subclass whose paths point at the forward tree

closed_sessions_only: a session D is requested only when D < today (ET); Basic serves D after its ET date ends; an open session stays SESSION_NOT_CLOSED
minute_symbols: union over collected closed sessions of the D-1 daily-eligible universe (E0 rule through app.strategy_e_v1_1.universe.daily_eligibility) plus SPY; each symbol is collected for every closed forward session so RVOL history stays contiguous

rate_limit.retries: client bounded retries, raw_fetch 120 s cooldown on RATE_LIMITED, collector backoff 60/120/300/600/900 s on transient codes; NOT_AUTHORIZED stops the run

locks.workspace: shared writer lock state/writer.lock.json, held per batch of 20 requests (historical_v2 convention)

grouped_daily: every bar dated D (no future or past row)
invalid OHLC and negative volume rows counted
minute: session in the requested XNYS range
validation.pass_required: only PASS files count for readiness; a FAIL is quarantined and refetched later
validation.split_pit_limit: the splits endpoint filters by execution date only; it has no publication-time as-of view, so splits_asof_<D> means 'executions <= D as retrieved at retrieved_at' (admissible for RECONSTRUCTED only)

append_only.corrupt: a file that no longer matches its sidecar stops the run; never overwritten
append_only.resume: a verified file costs zero calls; an interrupted minute request (ledger without sidecar) is validated on the next run

readiness.rvol_history_check: page level: every session among the 25 XNYS sessions ending D-1 (from the symbol's first collected page) is covered by a Common Raw, RVOL-context or verified forward page; the exact per-session RVOL range belongs to the F2 feature builder

forbidden: forward return, CAGR, MDD, PF, Sharpe
any change to H5, R1, max 3, B2, 2x / 3x, entry, exit or cost
files under app.strategy_e_max or app.backtest.strategy_e_max (M6 code identity)

verdict_labels.PASS: E-MAX-F1 PASS — FORWARD DATA READY FOR FEATURE BUILD

verdict_rule: PASS when every closed forward session is READY; PARTIAL when the collector works but a closed session is still NOT_READY for data not yet collected; BLOCKED when the source cannot supply a required input at all
